def kalman_filter(returns, phi, q, r, m0=0.0, p0=None):
    n=len(returns)
    if p0 is None: p0=q/(1-phi**2)
    pred_mean=[0.0]*n; pred_var=[0.0]*n; post_mean=[0.0]*n; post_var=[0.0]*n
    m=float(m0); p=float(p0)
    for i,y in enumerate(returns):
        # prior for latent mu_i is (m,p)
        pm=m; pv=p+r
        pred_mean[i]=pm; pred_var[i]=pv
        if y is None or (isinstance(y,float) and np.isnan(y)):
            # missing: no update; propagate
            mp=m; pp=p
        else:
            k=p/(p+r)
            mp=m+k*(float(y)-m); pp=p-k*p  # posterior
            pp=(1-k)*p
        m=phi*mp; p=phi*phi*pp+q
        post_mean[i]=mp; post_var[i]=pp
    return dict(pred_mean=pred_mean,pred_var=pred_var,post_mean=post_mean,post_var=post_var)

# run per segment
def run_segments(df):
    out_pm=[];out_pv=[];out_y=[];out_part=[];out_idx=[]
    d=df.reset_index(drop=True)
    seg=d['segment'].values
    for s in pd.unique(seg):
        sub=d[d['segment']==s]
        ret=sub['r_bps'].astype(float).values
        res=kalman_filter(list(ret),phi,Q,R)
        out_pm+=res['pred_mean']; out_pv+=res['pred_var']; out_y+=list(ret); out_part+=list(sub['partition'].values)
    return pd.DataFrame(dict(pm=out_pm,pv=out_pv,y=out_y,part=out_part))
